modified_caption: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising 13 slices. Each slice represents a specific data source with distinct labels, colors, and percentage values. The largest data source is NQ, accounting for approximately 31.3% of the dataset, followed by FEVER at 16.1%. SNLI and MULTINLI are the next largest contributors, with 15.4% and 11.3%, respectively. Notably, VITAMINC shows a steady decline in its contribution compared to previous years, now accounting for only 8.0% of the dataset. Additionally, SCIFACT and PUBHEALTH are among the smallest contributors, with SCIFACT slightly exceeding PUBHEALTH at 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each data source in the training set.

modifications.claim: VITAMINC shows a steady decline in its contribution compared to previous years, now accounting for only 8.0% of the dataset.
modifications.reality: The chart does not indicate any trend over time, and VITAMINC actually accounts for 13.0% of the dataset, not 8.0%.

modifications.claim: SCIFACT slightly exceeds PUBHEALTH at 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively.
modifications.reality: SCIFACT accounts for 0.1% of the dataset, which is less than PUBHEALTH's 0.5%.
